cases.given: two eligible candidates with identical scores
cases.when: decide runs one hundred times with the same clock
cases.then: the same backend wins every time through the declared tie-break

cases.given: a candidate whose E2 evidence is older than the policy window
cases.then: it fails C8 and the reason contains the age

cases.given: every candidate fails a hard constraint
cases.then: NoEligibleBackendError lists each backend with its constraint codes

cases.given: a request that requires prepared_rotation
cases.when: the OAR candidate does not declare it
cases.then: the candidate fails C3 while native stays eligible

cases.given: a multi-tenant request and a candidate without tenant-safe isolation
cases.then: that candidate fails C5

cases.given: E2 evidence with confidence below the policy floor
cases.then: C8 fails with the confidence in the reason

cases.given: a policy whose weights do not sum to one
cases.then: PolicyError names the weights problem and nothing is chosen

cases.given: a previous decision and no declared re-evaluation event
cases.then: the previous backend is returned with reasonCode sticky
cases.automation: test/selector.test.mjs#sticky decision survives an ordinary turn

cases.given: a sticky decision and a session_rotation event
cases.then: the selector re-evaluates and may change backend

cases.given: OAR scores higher than native while native has the lower priority number
cases.then: OAR wins; priority is used only for ties

cases.given: policy rollout allows only native
cases.then: it fails C6 and native is chosen

cases.given: the native backend for any catalog runtime
cases.then: it answers ok through the existing isolation
cases.automation: test/isolation.test.mjs#native always uses the existing isolation

cases.given: pi with OAR in-process execution
cases.then: it answers ineligible because per-session env cannot reach the extension

cases.given: a runtime whose OAR isolation mapping is not verified
cases.then: it answers pending and the selector treats the OAR backend as ineligible

cases.given: an agent descriptor with dataDir and ovConfig
cases.then: the six ownership switches are 0 and the ovConfig path is present

cases.given: the committed spec files
cases.then: it reports ok with full requirement coverage

cases.given: a spec with a duplicate id, an orphan test and a dangling task dependency
cases.then: each problem is reported with its code
cases.automation: test/spec-validate.test.mjs#duplicate, orphan and dangling links are reported

cases.given: a gate with one passing and one failing check
cases.then: the report marks the gate failed and keeps both checks
cases.automation: test/gate.test.mjs#a failing check fails the gate

cases.given: a passing gate report and evidence changed afterwards
cases.then: it fails on the hash mismatch

cases.given: the replay fixture
cases.then: mismatches is zero and the agreement field is reported

cases.given: a task DAG with one done task and one todo dependent
cases.then: only the unblocked task is ready; a cycle is reported

cases.given: a matrix entry marked available with E1 evidence
cases.then: the matrix entry is rejected

cases.given: a successful decision
cases.then: it carries ids, versions, candidates, choice, reason and fallback chain
